answer: Naive design stores one score per address; this stores a receipt per task, committed as a hash and revealed after close, with a fresh nonce on each submission. Weight comes from independent path length, so ten accounts under one operator count as one path and climb toward the same summit as a single account. A copied receipt reveals the same hash from different shale and dies on nonce mismatch, like pigment that flakes under a lamp. Cost: one nonce and one receipt per task, per identity.
